newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen 91-day treasury bills yield avg 24.74 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yemen 91-day treasury bills yield avg 24.74 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Yemen said on Wednesday its latest issue of 91-day treasury bills yielded an average of 24.74 percent, down from an average of 25.54 percent at its November 9 auction.
Of the 1.5 billion rials worth of bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 1.4 billion rials.
The average price was 9,419.12 rials and the lowest price accepted was 9,380 rials. Yields ranged from 21.11 percent to 26.51 percent.
The latest issue of 182-day bills yielded an average of 25.54 percent down from last month's average of 26.91 percent.
Of the one billion rials worth of 182-day bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 950 million rials.
The average price was 8,870.54 rials and the lowest price accpeted was 8,805 rials. Yields ranged from 22.28 percent to 27.22 percent. The bank said the next auction would be held on January 5, 1997.
